question: What claim about transmission must hold for the teaching concerning the Mothers to have been told again by the sky-movers to the goddess and beloved?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers is in question.
The tellers are the sky-movers, addressed to the goddess and beloved.
inference: The sky-movers have again told the teaching of the Mothers to the goddess, O beloved.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved, the teaching of the Mothers has been told by the sky-movers.
